item.title: Aquis weekly movers: Ajax Resources buying majority stake in Paguanta project
item.summary: Shares in Gledhow Investments (LON: GDH) continue to rise following the previous week’s announcement of a greater focus on natural resources and commitments for a £400,000 subscription at 1p/share, which was more than double the market price at the time.
